start.checking: Checking if the live checker is on.

stand.noRecord: We found nothing in your records for this.
stand.open: Open a line to see what your records say.

missing.title: What's missing
missing.intro: Get these before you send your appeal. Each one can help your case.
missing.nothingMissing: Your records show every part of the rule.
missing.tickNote: Your ticks stay on this device only.

letter.intro: Pick any sentence to see the rule and the record line it comes from.
letter.unconfirmedIntro: We took these out of the letter. Check them against your records before you add any back.
letter.fillIn: Fill in the parts in [square brackets] before you send it.
letter.pick: Pick a sentence in the letter. Its record line and the rule show up here.

chances.range: About {low} to {high} out of 100 similar appeals won.
chances.ifFixed: If you fix this: about {p} out of 100

chances.bestGuess: Our best guess is about {p} out of 100.

chances.eachPart: How each part of the rule counts
chances.notAvailable: We can't give a number for this case right now.
chances.noNumber: We give no number when a required paper is missing. Any number would be a guess.

download.title: Download your letter
download.beforeSend: Read every line and fill in your details before you send it.
download.wordBest: Best if you want to type in your name and address.
download.pdfBest: Best for printing or sending online.
steps: Fill in your name, address, member ID and the date where you see brackets.
Read each line next to your own records. Take out anything that is wrong.
Add the papers from the list of what's missing, if you got them.
Send it before the date on your denial letter. Keep a copy.
download.failed: We could not make the file. Try again, or use the other format.
